questions.a: (1) The flags architecture is presence-based zero-byte files with a MENU/SIGNAL split: flags/ is definitions (permanent), ground_loop/ is active signals (transient copies). This is Akiens design, ruled 2026-08-19.
(2) The beat cadence IS the flag-response latency — currently ~8-9s. No sub-second response promised or needed.
(3) Restart means clean exit, not exec-in-place. The launcher (superclaude) already spawns; the respawn policy is the launchers concern, not the ground loops.
